obernants.approximation_semantics: Scoped mathematical relation, distinct from floating-point implementation and finite evidence. No shared percentage metric.
obernants.assumptions: Frequency error/N, quantile value/rank intervals and floating variance are different metrics. Moment arithmetic has no universal relative-error certificate. Map allocation failure lies outside the Result contract; histogram allocation is fallible.
obernants.domain: Finite streams in the configured histogram domain, legal frequency tiers, moment count <=2^53 and representable moments; only common accepted updates in cross-component joins.
obernants.evidence: model.md#wave19-evidence; exact transitive revisions in source_bindings.

obernants.operator: Exclude frequency intervals omitting the exact accepted-stream count, rank/value rectangles omitting the sorted requested rank, mismatched accepted-prefix N and successful nonfinite moment output. A rejected individual update must not mutate that component; no cross-component rollback is promised.
